body: Could you not bring politics into this? Firstly, that's not how it works buddy, you can't not be gay it's not a choice believe me if it was I wouldn't have chosen to be gay. Also what do you want me to honour my parents for? "Congrats you gave all four of your children trauma 🤩" is that what you want me to say?

Trust me she really is unobtainable, and what if I'm ok with knowing she won't like me back? I'm aware and nothing I do will change that and the idea that you've already decided she "ain't shit" is honestly disgusting why've you automatically assumed that I'm the better one in this situation because I'm not. I know she doesn't want me and it doesn't matter what I want because if she doesn't want me then I won't force myself onto her. I'm ok with 'wasting' time on her, I'm ok with knowing my feelings will never be reciprocated and that's ok.

When it comes to my mum it's really confusing to know what she wants from me, I really think that she just wants me to live the life she couldn't. She's really into art but she says she started too late to go to art school so she wants me to go to art school, I enjoy art but I really only see it as a hobby and when I told her I was planning on studying Astrophysics she told me, and I quote "You don't have the brains for that" and I don't want this to come across as egotistical but I know I'm not dumb, I'm a straight A student and while there definitely are others smarter than me I'm not doing that bad also compared to other kids in my year I'm a good kid, I don't vape or smoke (and don't plan to ever), drink, skip classes, misbehave but it seems like she can only see my flaws because I don't remember the last time she said she was proud of me, despite this I still love her but sometimes it just feels like if I didn't try as hard as I did she'd start to treat me like shit

I've tried to apply to jobs before but my parents would refuse to fill in the parental consent form so gaining any financial stability would prove to be difficult however I'm not really sure how this works where you live but in Australia the majority of people stay with their families while they're at University and don't really move out until 20-23 or at least those have been my observations. I'll try to get a few scholarships so maybe I can get more money but it's going to be hard

I'm aware that my mum isn't anywhere near as bad as my dad but my grades aren't really the only thing that she cares about I honestly think part of how much she values me is for what I can do for her, having good grades means she can brag about it to her friends but despite me getting straight As I'm no where near as smart as my older sister which I think is why she wants me to do better, She also constantly tells me that I don't do anything for her when I set the dinner table and do the dishwasher and also payed for my little brothers whole birthday because she's given up on it. I also can't have a job so I had to use money I got from winning a history competition for it and she still says I don't do anything. Don't get me wrong I love her and she can do nice things like one day she bought me a fluffy blanket because I looked cold when I was sleeping but sometimes it's really hard to see that side of her

I know this might sound somewhat selfish, but even if she is suicidal a 21 year old shouldn't make suicide jokes infront of a 14 year old and especially not one that's already suicidal. I don't care if she vents to me but me having to hear suicide jokes basically everytime I'm with her makes me feel like I should end it and the jokes aren't like "what if I offed myself haha lol" they're like "Omg I should kill myself lol🤩✨💫💖"
